issues.reason: Propositional attitudes grants the flat-plus-sealed dual-emit only to FACTIVES (know / realize / discover / regret) and rules that a non-factive's "sealed term is P's only trace"; confirm belongs with the speech verbs the section lists as non-factive (claim, say), and the Can modal hedges it further, so repeating the whole investigation proposition as sibling conjuncts adds a claim the seal was meant to withhold.

Propositional attitudes fixes the holder role for "a verb of thought or speech with a clausal that-complement" as Experiencer, and the parse itself applies that to say — giving confirm Agent makes one sentence encode the same construction two ways, which the same-role-in-statement-and-question discipline forbids.

gaps_confirmed: direct quotation introduced by a colon — nothing states whether quoted speech becomes a sealed that-complement of the quoting verb or something else
first-person "we" inside quoted speech — the pronoun rules cover he/she/it/they only and give no route for binding a speaker pronoun to the quoting subject
new_gaps: confirm / deny / acknowledge are unclassified — the factive and non-factive lists name neither, so whether P flattens is left to judgment

no rule for how the definite-referent projection rule applies through TWO nested seals (a quote inside an attitude): the sealed proposition's definites currently project nowhere, while (Name iraq "Iraq") is projected all the way out on the name-is-a-label precedent
repair_summary: Removed the duplicated flat copy of the investigation proposition from the say-complement's (And ...), leaving it only under (Theme sk_confirm_1 ...); changed (Agent sk_confirm_1 ministry_of_defence) to (Experiencer sk_confirm_1 ministry_of_defence).
notes: Everything outside the confirm bundle stands: the opaque multi-word organization name plus separate kind atom, the agentless progressive passive, the reduced-relative expansion of "allegations surrounding ...", and the deictic Time constant with no TODAY.
